subject: reasoning
question:
Words given on the left side of (∶∶) are related with each other by some Logic/Rule /Relation. Select the missing word/word pair on the right side of (∶∶) from the given alternatives based on the same Logic/Rule/Relation.

Site ∶ Engineer ∶∶ ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Site ∶ Engineer → An engineer is associated with a specific location where they work.

Similarly,

House ∶ Servant → A servant is associated with a specific House where they work.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

Waiter ∶ Restaurant → A Waiter is associated with a specific Restaurant where they work.

Grocer ∶ Shop → A Grocer is associated with a specific Shop where they work.

Scientist ∶ Laboratory → A Scientist is associated with a specific Laboratory where they work.
